Electrical wiring schematic for a muffle assembly, showing the power supply, heating elements, temperature-control components, and optional pyrometer connection.

- MUFFLE: contains two heating elements, each marked 12 OHMS.
- PY50 TYPE K T/C: thermocouple connected to the muffle. Its leads terminate at a four-terminal block. A note states, “CUSTOMER-FURNISHED PYROMETER (IF USED) CONNECTS HERE.”
- CR19: #12-3 CORDSET with a 5-20P cap. The cap view identifies N, W, and G terminals. The G terminal connects to the CASE GROUND.
- MS8 PILOT LIGHT: connected to the infinite control switch.
- SW5 INFINITE CONTROL SWITCH, 120V: terminals are labeled TOP, PL, L1, L2, H1, and H2.
- TF17: 30A RELAY, 120V COIL. Its coil terminals are marked 0 and 1. Contact terminals are marked 2, 4, 6, and 8.
- Power wiring: the supply’s W conductor connects to the switch’s L1 terminal. The switch’s L2 terminal connects to relay contact terminal 2. Relay contact terminal 4 connects to the upper heating element. Relay contact terminal 6 connects to the lower heating element. Relay contact terminal 8 connects to the switch’s H2 terminal. The switch’s H1 terminal connects to the supply’s N conductor.
- Pilot-light wiring: the switch’s PL terminal connects to the MS8 pilot light. The pilot light’s other lead connects to the switch’s TOP terminal.
- Relay coil wiring: the relay coil terminal 0 connects to the switch’s L2 terminal. The relay coil terminal 1 connects to the switch’s H2 terminal.
- Wire-color labels: WH at the relay contact terminal 4 connection; BLK at the relay contact terminal 6 connection.
- POWER REQ’TS: 120 VOLTS; 1 PHASE; 50/60 HERTZ; 20 AMPS; 2400 WATTS; MAX TEMP 1700° F.
- WIRE SIZES: NOTE: ALL WIRES TO BE TYPE SEW/SF2, #14 AWG MINIMUM UNLESS NOTED.
